findings.title: Removed historical worktree metadata silently drops retained findings
findings.evidence: In isolated two-linked-worktree fixture, two defect rows under old checkout key and a neutral common-directory seed yield sameDefectFailures=2 through actual catalog_live_lineage -> guarded reader -> load_snapshot and cmd_status. Removing only old checkout .git changes count to 0 with no operational-history gap; both defect rows remain. Restoring metadata restores count2.

findings.title: Active reservation without its own start borrows a finished reservation profile
findings.evidence: Finish a local-runtime verify reservation, insert an active verify reservation with identical repository/requirement/capability/candidate/action identity but a different reservation ID and no action_start. get_history primaryActive=false, has_other_primary=false, and a second live reservation succeeds.
findings.cause: _action_start_profiles returns all fallback profiles when no reservationId match exists, including starts explicitly belonging to different finished reservations. This converts unknown active profile into known non-live.
findings.requiredChange: Never use an action_start explicitly bound to another reservation as evidence of this reservation profile. If current active reservation profile cannot be positively attributed, occupy the primary slot. Handle legacy untagged starts conservatively; add all-three-consumer test with an older finished non-live start plus missing current start.
